traditionsNote: Distinguish Hebrew language, Jewish Kabbalah, Hermetic Qabalah, astrology and personal interpretation. These traditions overlap in some modern practices but are not interchangeable.
scope: Reference data only (sephiroth names/meanings, 22 paths, gematria methods, Moon/Monday, Heh/Zayin/Cheth facts). Personal practice material from the source package is intentionally excluded.

pathsNote.value: Golden Dawn style; path number = 11 + letter index; connections use sephiroth numbers. Letter images are traditional Hermetic study glosses, not a complete account of historical letter-name etymology. Strength/Justice numbering follows the Rider-Waite-Smith convention; other decks differ; Crowley exchanges Heh/Tzaddi attributions.

pillarsNote.value: The three pillars are often called severity (left), mercy (right), and mildness or balance (middle); left and right refer to the diagram as viewed.

daath.value: Da'ath: knowledge; not an additional numbered sephirah in this arrangement.

description.value: Adds letter values. Final forms ך ם ן ף ץ retain 20, 40, 50, 80, 90 in this method.
Some other methods assign different final-form values. Do not mix methods within a comparison.
A letter and its spelled name have different totals (e.g. ז = 7; זין = 7 + 10 + 50 = 67).
A separate operation from summing (1 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 6 differs from 12 + 12 = 24). Record which operation is used; do not change it to obtain a preferred match.
Treating a clock time (e.g. 12:12 as two twelves) as gematria is a chosen interpretive method, not a universal rule.

correction.value: Binah (בינה) = 67, not 391. 391 is the value of Yehoshua (יהושע); do not label 391 as the value of Binah.

day.value: Monday is associated with the Moon in the traditional planetary weekday cycle.
day.note: Traditional planetary weekday cycle (astrological), as used in Hermetic practice.

lunarThemes.value: Receptivity, memory, reflection and changing conditions, used as contemplative symbols; they do not establish how a person must feel or act.

constellationVsSign.value: A constellation map and tropical zodiac signs use different reference systems.

jewishTeaching.value: In Letters of Light, Heh is associated with thought, speech and action, and its opening with return and repentance.

arithmeticEquality.value: זין (67) = בינה (Binah, 67): an arithmetic equality using these spellings, not proof of an inevitable event.

conflicts.note: Source gives only Fire; existing data also carries Spirit. Not contradictory; both kept under their own sources.
Source gives only Saturn; existing data also carries Earth. Not contradictory; both kept under their own sources.
